text:
```yaml
name: Claude MD Check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'CLAUDE.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-claude-size:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Check CLAUDE.md character count
        id: check_size
        run: |
          CHAR_COUNT=$(wc -m < CLAUDE.md)
          echo "Current character count: $CHAR_COUNT"
          if [ $CHAR_COUNT -gt 25000 ]; then
            echo "Error: CLAUDE.md exceeds 25,000 characters limit"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "size=$CHAR_COUNT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
      - name: Report size
        run: |
          echo "CLAUDE.md is ${{ steps.check_size.outputs.size }} characters long"
          
      - name: Validate Markdown formatting
        run: |
          # Basic markdown validation
          if ! grep -q "^# " CLAUDE.md; then
            echo "Error: CLAUDE.md must start with a main heading"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for proper section structure
          if ! grep -q "^## " CLAUDE.md; then
            echo "Warning: CLAUDE.md should have at least one subsection"
          fi
          
          echo "Markdown format appears valid"
```
